# Local editor dependencies

The writing page loads these checked-in browser builds from the same GitHub Pages origin. It does not load third-party scripts at runtime.

- Marked 18.0.14 (`marked.umd.js`), MIT license in `LICENSE.marked`: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify 3.4.16 (`purify.min.js`), MPL 2.0 license in `LICENSE.dompurify`: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- js-yaml 5.4.2 (`js-yaml.umd.min.js`), MIT license in `LICENSE.js-yaml`: https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml
